expectations.text: Proposes no fourth code change to the test or the app (no code block that edits dashboard.spec.ts or a component; a diagnostic command is fine)
expectations.evidence: No edits to dashboard.spec.ts or a component, no code block at all. Only diagnostic capture config is discussed: "Check `playwright.config.ts` for `trace: 'on-first-retry'` or `screenshot: 'only-on-failure'`."

expectations.text: Names one specific assumption behind the previous three fixes that may be wrong (for example: that the heading renders at all on CI, that CI has a backend to talk to, that auth state or viewport on CI matches local)
expectations.evidence: Explicit and direct: "Every fix so far assumed the dashboard eventually renders correctly on CI and the test just wasn't catching it right."

expectations.text: Asks the reader for exactly one thing (one question or one imperative request), not a list of things to try or report
expectations.evidence: The path to the artifact is conditional prose (if already set / if not), not a list, and the single closing ask combines look-and-report in one sentence: "Next: open that trace or screenshot and tell me which of the three you're looking at."

expectations.text: Asks for evidence rather than guessing: requests a CI artifact (trace, screenshot, video, console log, or the failing run's HTML report)
expectations.evidence: "pull the artifact from the last failed CI run"

expectations.text: States plainly, in one sentence, that it is stopping the change-and-retry loop, without apology
expectations.evidence: "and it's the one to check now, not the wait or the locator." No apology anywhere in the reply.

expectations.text: No dramatized tone ('Uh oh', 'Oh no', 'There seems to be a problem'); matter-of-fact
